about_the_game:
Introduction

"The Mirror Edge" is a first-person horror adventure game set in the urban landscape of Hong Kong. The story follows a young man who arrives at his sister’s apartment to uncover the truth behind her mysterious disappearance. However, his journey takes a bizarre and unsettling turn due to a series of unexpected events…

About the Game

"The Mirror Edge" is a horror adventure game set in modern-day Hong Kong, blending local culture and folklore. Players will freely explore the game’s richly detailed environments, immersing themselves in the distinct atmosphere of Hong Kong.

Story Background

In 2023, a series of bizarre disappearances plague "Wing Lee Building" in Central, Hong Kong—one of the victims being your sister. With the police at a dead end, you play as Ah Kit, her older brother, who returns from the UK to investigate. After moving into this eerie tenement, you discover a strange and ghostly mirror world hidden within its walls… and the residents seem to be hiding terrifying secrets.

Game Features

✅ Immersive Hong Kong Horror Atmosphere – Dilapidated tenements, dimly lit hallways, and unsettling residents—every detail recreates the unique vibe of old Hong Kong.
✅ Suspenseful, Twisting Narrative – Unravel the truth layer by layer, leading to a shocking finale.
✅ Tenement Exploration – Navigate the building and its mirror world, solving environmental puzzles while evading vengeful spirits.
✅ Survival & Puzzle-Solving – Gather clues, decipher talismans, and escape the threats of a sinister cult’s rituals.
✅ Unique Enemy Designs – Cult-controlled residents, wandering ghosts, and twisted creatures lurking in the mirrors…

Adventure

Venture through the eerie Wing Lee Building and its haunted mirror world, uncovering hidden clues in every corner—from torn diary pages and old photographs to mysterious talismans. Piece together the truth behind the disappearances and expose the terrifying secrets buried within this tenement.

Puzzles

Blending old Hong Kong folklore with supernatural phenomena, the game features intricately designed puzzles and mechanisms. Decipher diary entries and talismans, disrupt occult rituals, and manipulate the rules of the mirror world to survive the shifting boundary between reality and illusion.

Enemies

You are not alone. Possessed residents, vengeful spirits, and grotesque mirror-dwelling abominations lurk in the shadows, ready to strike. Stay hidden, use the environment wisely, and fight for survival in the face of despair.

Minimum:

  • Processor: Core i5 processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（must support DirectX 9.0c or higher）
